observations: I opened assets/panels/06-1.png, main-cast.png and page-06.png and looked at them myself. This is a close-up of the laptop. The dark bezel, camera dot and hinge are visible, with the window frame and a plant leaf at the upper right, a blue chair edge at the left, and the wooden desk along the bottom.

The screen has a slim teal header bar and three tiles. The left tile is a tooth arch chart with two teal teeth. The centre tile is an eye diagram with three teal marker dots and leader lines. The right tile is a rising growth curve on a grid beside a card with three ticks. Each tile has a blank band at the bottom. I found no letters or numbers. A small framed picture at the upper left of the wall is abstract.

A right hand rests on the trackpad at the lower right. A white coat cuff with a teal kurta edge is visible, which matches Ananya as the production notes require. Her left hand is out of frame. The fingers read correctly.

Non-blocking: the laptop faces the reader almost head-on rather than at the three-quarter angle the scene describes. It still reads clearly as Ananya's laptop because her hand and the room are visible.

On page-06.png the header label sits in the header bar and the three tile labels sit on the tile bands. The paediatrician label slightly overlaps the keyboard edge but not the hand. The hand is uncovered.
